summary: Verified sticky-header UX fix on Blue Margins. Tested desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x800) sticky behavior, anchor-offset for all sections, mobile menu open/close, and regression (poem modal, books links, contact copy, no /api calls, no console errors). All acceptance criteria pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sticky header confirmed on desktop (top=0 at scrollY=1800 and at bottom) and mobile (top=0 at scrollY=1500). Anchor offsets: About/Poems/Books/Journal all land at ~96px (>=88 required); Contact lands at 383px (short section). No horizontal overflow at 390px (sw==cw==390). Mobile menu opens on toggle and closes after clicking a link; books section lands at ~136px below sticky header. Regression: Wallflowers poem modal opens; Books shows Sea, Sand, Wind with Amazon (amzn.in) + Notion Press links; Contact shows Let's Connect with 0 email input fields; no /api/* requests; no console errors. Desktop nav shows all 6 links (Home, About, Poems, Books, Journal, Contact).
rca_of_the_issue: Prior overflow-x: hidden on ancestor (html/App) broke position: sticky because it creates a scroll container. Fix uses overflow-x: clip on body only, which prevents horizontal scroll without creating a scroll container, so sticky header pins to viewport. scroll-margin-top: 6rem on main section[id] pushes anchor targets below the h-24 (96px) sticky header.
